business_purpose: Size of the external SME location base a sales team could address
population: 35 full-framework CMAs (41-CMA percentile shown separately for scale-only CMAs)

business_purpose: New-business formation that creates new banking relationships; moves with closures, so it measures churn intensity, not net growth
source_columns: value where measure = 'opening_rate', industry_code_0722 = '1', size_band_key = 'TOTAL', ref_month 2025-06 to 2026-05
statistical_unit: ratio to active enterprises at t-1 (monthly)

business_purpose: Whether the employer-business population is currently expanding
source_columns: value where measure = 'net_formation_rate', industry_code_0722 = '1', size_band_key = 'TOTAL', ref_month 2025-06 to 2026-05
statistical_unit: ratio to active enterprises at t-1 (monthly)

business_purpose: Whether net formation has been strengthening over three years
transformation: OLS slope of monthly net-formation rate on a calendar-month index, x12 (per year)
source_columns: value where measure = 'net_formation_rate', industry_code_0722 = '1', size_band_key = 'TOTAL', ref_month 2023-06 to 2026-05

component_name: Commercial fit: 20-99 employee share of SME locations
business_purpose: Share of SME locations in the established-SME band typical of business-banking relationships
population: 35 full-framework CMAs (41-CMA percentile shown separately for scale-only CMAs)

component_name: Stability: scale-adjusted volatility of net formation
business_purpose: Month-to-month instability beyond what market size explains (smaller CMAs are mechanically noisier)
transformation: residual of log10(12-month SD of net-formation rate) regressed on log10(SME locations) across the 35 CMAs
source_columns: value where measure = 'net_formation_rate' (SD over 2025-06 to 2026-05); locations where size_scope = 'sme_1_499'

component_name: Stability: unadjusted volatility of net formation
business_purpose: Comparison variant: raw month-to-month instability, which also penalises markets that are already small on scale
transformation: log10 of the 12-month SD of net-formation rate
